## Description

Regresses returns on market/sector/style factors and trades unusually large idiosyncratic residual moves toward their modeled baseline.

## Where it may fit

Short-horizon stock-specific dislocations where common factor exposures can be hedged and residual behavior remains stable.

## Vehicles

Equity market-neutral and statistical-arbitrage funds.

## Required data

Point-in-time returns, market/sector/style factors, rolling regression windows, borrow availability, spreads and costs.

## Caveats

Factor model misspecification can turn apparent residual alpha into hidden factor exposure; require live-like borrow and turnover accounting.
